Metewand compares computational methods across languages. You write ordinary
Python or R functions and declare the comparison in YAML. The command-line
runner executes methods as separate processes, evaluates their answers
independently, and retains settings, timings, metrics, failures, and provenance.

The runner supports parameter grids, retries, resuming runs, and exporting
results for analysis. Metewand is under active development, with Python and R
packages and support for native Rust workers.
